features.text: Designed for harsh environments, our busbar trunking systems offer ingress protection up to IP66, ensuring they are dust-tight and protected against powerful water jets, suitable for industrial and outdoor use.

features.title: Certified for Seismic zone-V compliance
features.text: Our busduct systems are certified for Seismic zone-V compliance, guaranteeing they can withstand severe seismic activity, ensuring continuous operation and structural integrity in earthquake-prone areas.
